# Breaking News: SimplyAgree Secures $3 Million in Funding to Revolutionize Signature and Closing Management for Attorneys

We are excited to announce that SimplyAgree has successfully raised $3 million in funding to further bolster our innovative signature and closing management tool designed specifically for transactional attorneys. Renowned for our association with some of the most prestigious law firms, including those in the AmLaw 100 and Global 100 rankings, SimplyAgree streamlines and automates the intricate administrative tasks that accompany legal closings. Our platform efficiently manages everything from signature packets to closing binders, allowing attorneys to concentrate on what truly matters: closing deals and delivering unparalleled value to their clients. This new injection of capital will enable us to expand our technological capabilities, enhance user experience, and accelerate product development to better serve our growing client base. As the legal landscape continues to evolve, we remain committed to providing our clients with best-in-class solutions that not only optimize their workflows but also ensure compliance and minimize risks. With this funding, we aim to advance our mission of simplifying the closing process, enabling legal professionals to drive efficiency and achieve greater success in their transactions. We are grateful for the support from our investors and look forward to the exciting journey ahead as we continue to redefine how transactional attorneys manage signature and closing processes. Stay tuned for more updates as we develop new features and expand our reach in the legal technology space!

## About SimplyAgree

SimplyAgree is a tool that assists transactional attorneys within the legal sector. The company provides a platform that automates the creation of signature packets, manages eSignatures, compiles documents, and produces closing binders, all related to legal transactions. SimplyAgree serves the legal industry, specifically in transactional law practices. It was founded in 1900 and is based in Nashville, Tennessee.
